name: Jumbo Cart API
description: Adds products to the Jumbo cart using the Webfuse Automation API. Registers MCP tool jumbo_add_to_cart.

tools.name: jumbo_add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the Jumbo shopping cart by clicking its add-to-cart button using the Webfuse Automation API. The button is targeted by CSS selector. Optionally scroll the button into view first. Returns success status and current cart count.

selector.description: CSS selector for the add-to-cart button (from jumbo_search results)

tools.name: jumbo_get_cart_count
tools.description: Check the current Jumbo cart item count by taking a DOM snapshot and looking for the cart badge.
